svg.text: AGENTICEVAL · EXPERIMENTS/QUESTIONS/COMPLEX.YAML · EIGHT TURNS, ONE STATEFUL SESSION
SURFACES WHAT HAPPENED ⇢ ASKS WHAT IT MEANS
“Any spending spikes? What are the drivers for it?”
“How did TSR and CDSS react? While the TSR and CDSS were
reacting, how was the bureau profile?”
“What are the differences before and after the recent reaction of
TSR and CDSS? Any changes regarding spending patterns, drivers?”
“Summarize the abnormal transactions when TSR was reacting
“What transactions are connected? Is there a default pattern? Is
the behaviour intentional, accidental or explainable?”
explainable. 7 and 8 attack it from each side.

WHY THE ORDER IS THE DESIGN
The suite is asked top to bottom in one session. Turns 1–2 stand alone; the reaction cluster fixes a window that two
follow-ups inherit; the reading cluster commits to a verdict, then argues both sides of it in separate turns.
